scope: Layered SVG contract and actual browser UI inspection; no Unity or physical device animation qualification.
checks: Every declared layer and pivot names an existing unique SVG element
Four motion selections change the visible state; bucket is visible only in carry mode
Facing controls mirror the character; pause/resume and pace controls update
Attachment guides are visible and follow the animated pose in visual inspection
Narrow 390px layout inspected; observed document content width 375px, no horizontal overflow
Normal viewport restored and interactive preview left open
limitations: The SVG is a rig study, not approved final character art
No Unity import, production SpriteSkin/Animator, physical A10 performance or network integration tested
Browser DOM bridge does not expose getScreenCTM, so no pixel-precision attachment assertion is claimed
